title: KB Securities Prepares Multi-Chain Tokenized Securities Platform
why_it_matters: Supporting multiple networks may reduce dependence on a single infrastructure provider, but coordination between brokerages remains an operational hurdle for continuous settlement.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

KB Securities Prepares Multi-Chain Tokenized Securities Platform

The Korean brokerage is preparing money market funds for domestic and overseas markets while examining how financial institutions can operate settlement systems around the clock.
